info.title: Analytics API
info.description: Read-only query service over ClickHouse. Serves declarative metric definitions, computed metric results and their evidence, plus tenant-authored saved queries. The API Gateway mounts this service at /api/analytics.

get.summary: Whether this instance explains metrics with AI
Context entries the caller's explanations read
Whether the caller has an Anthropic key stored

put.summary: Store or replace the caller's Anthropic key

get.summary: The system prompt in force for this tenant
Feedback sent in a date range
Get a custom metric by key
Get a saved query by id

requestBody.description: Optional named parameters (`period`); `tenant` is always injected from context

get.summary: Usage summary for a date range

enabled.description: Whether this deployment offers AI explanations at all.

model.description: The model explanations are asked of.

hint.description: Last four characters of the stored key; empty when none is stored.

is_default.description: True while the tenant has written none of its own.

CreateSavedQueryRequest.description: Request to create a saved query.

CustomMetric.description:
A portable custom-metric graph — the create/update body, the export item,
and the get/list detail shape. `origin` is response-only: always `"custom"`
on output, omitted from exports, and ignored on input (writes force
`custom`).

subject.description:
The single topic this metric groups under within its family; a
lowercase snake-case slug. Optional for custom metrics.

tags.description:
Cross-cutting filter labels; lowercase snake-case slugs, unique per
metric. Optional — defaults to empty.

CustomMetricInput.description: One role→measure binding of a custom metric.

CustomMetricSummary.description: List item — display fields only, no SQL body.

subject.description:
Grouping subject, so the management list can partition custom metrics
by topic like the definitions listing; absent when none is declared.

person_context_entries.description: How many of the caller's own entries fed the prompt.

tenant_context_entries.description: How many organisation entries fed the prompt.

ExportCustomMetricsResponse.description: `GET /v1/metrics/export` envelope — the tenant's custom metric graphs.

display_name.description: Empty when the sender has not been mirrored into the identity rows yet.

username.description: The account handle, empty when no identity row carries one.

path.description: The screen the sender was on. Empty when the SPA cannot name one.

bins.description:
Empty when the entity has no events in the period — the entity is
still listed, mirroring the period view's every-requested-entity rule.

ImportCustomMetricsResponse.description:
`POST /v1/metrics/import` result — counts landed and the `metric_key`s
skipped because they already existed for the tenant.

MetricDefinitionListResponse.description:
Response body for `GET /v1/metric-definitions`. Metrics are sorted by
`metric_key` ascending so the payload is byte-stable for caching and
diff tooling.

MetricDefinitionView.description: One metric definition, display fields only.

last_observed_date.description:
Newest `metric_date` ever observed across the definition's input
measures; absent when no observation has ever been seen. Freshness
signal, orthogonal to `schema_status`. Not maintained for `custom`
metrics (see `origin`).

origin.description:
`builtin` metrics read managed observation relations; `custom` metrics
execute inline SQL at query time. The validator stamps `schema_status`
and `last_observed_date` from materialized relations only, so for
`custom` those fields stay `unchecked` / absent regardless of data —
readers must not interpret them as "never measured" for custom metrics.

revision_window_days.description:
How many days back from `last_observed_date` the suppliers may still
revise. Absent where the source declares none, and for `custom` metrics,
which read no managed source — absence means "settles on arrival", not
"revised forever". Registry knowledge, not tenant state, so it is read
from the seed rather than stored per row.

oneOf.description:
Why `schema_status` is `error`; absent otherwise (the DB enforces the
biconditional).

short_label.description:
Compact label for dense surfaces; absent when the full label is
already compact enough.

subject.description:
The single topic this metric belongs to within its family, so a surface
listing a family can partition it into topics rather than only sorting
by name. Exactly one per metric; absent only for metrics that declare
none.

tags.description:
Cross-cutting labels a surface can filter or search by; many per metric,
unlike the singular `subject`. Empty when the metric declares none.

MetricSnapshot.description: The tile as the reader sees it, handed to the model as the thing to explain.

delta.description: The tile's own change line, empty when it has none.

help.description: The catalog's description of the metric, empty when it has none.

peer.description: The tile's peer-comparison line, empty when it has none.

period.description: What the period is called on screen, e.g. `month`.

value.description: The formatted value the tile shows.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem+json. `context` varies by error category.

RunResponse.description:
Result of `POST /v1/queries/{id}/run`.

`rows` carry a per-query dynamic schema (the `SELECT` columns vary), so each
row is an untyped JSON object — the same shape as the metric query path.

RunSavedQueryRequest.description:
Optional parameters for `POST /v1/queries/{id}/run` (#1966).

The `{tenant}` parameter is always injected from the session context and is
never client-settable, so it is absent here. `period` is the first optional
named parameter an author can reference as `{period:<Type>}`; it is bound as
a ClickHouse server-side parameter, never interpolated into the SQL text.

SavedQuerySummary.description: Summary returned by the list endpoint (no `sql` body).

Scope.description: Who a context entry belongs to.

time_sent.description: Epoch milliseconds on the same clock: when the batch was flushed.

time_triggered.description: Epoch milliseconds on the browser's clock: when the event happened.

UpdateSavedQueryRequest.description:
Request to update a saved query.

`description` uses double-Option (absent → unchanged, `null` → clear,
value → set), matching [`super::metric::UpdateMetricRequest`].

enabled.description: Whether this instance records usage at all.

UsageIngestRequest.description:
SDK v2 body. Fields shared by every record are hoisted out of them into
`meta`, so a record carries only what differs.

display_name.description: Empty when the visitor has not been mirrored into the identity rows yet.

username.description: The account handle, empty when no identity row carries one.

ValueTransform.description:
Affine + clamp shaping for a computed metric value:
`y = clamp(clamp_min, clamp_max, multiplier * x + offset)`.
Absent fields are identity (multiplier 1, offset 0, no bound).
